MODE 5: REG (Paired-Variable Regression)

Enter (x, y) pairs with x , y DT, press AC, then recall coefficients A, B (and C for Quad) and r from S-VAR.

MODE 5 (REG) stores paired samples and fits one regression model. A REG indicator appears. In REG the M+ key becomes DT (data register). You cannot use independent memory M+ here — every DT stores an (x, y) pair instead.

Regression models (pick one before entering data)

  • LinEnter x , y DT pairs (≥2), AC, then recall A, B, and r. Fitted line: y = A + Bx.
  • LogEnter x , y DT pairs (≥2, all x > 0), AC, then recall A, B, and r. Fitted curve: y = A + B ln x.
  • ExpEnter x , y DT pairs (≥2), AC, then recall A, B, and r. Fitted curve: y = A e^(Bx).
  • PwrEnter x , y DT pairs (≥2, all x > 0 and y > 0), AC, then recall A, B, and r. Fitted curve: y = A x^B.
  • InvEnter x , y DT pairs (≥2, x ≠ 0), AC, then recall A, B, and r. Fitted curve: y = A + B/x.
  • QuadEnter x , y DT for at least 3 pairs, press AC, then recall A, B, C. Fitted parabola: y = A + Bx + Cx².
  • AB-ExpEnter x , y DT pairs (≥2, y > 0), AC, then recall A, B, and r. Fitted curve: y = A B^x. Distinct from Exp (y = A e^(Bx)).

Clear old data

Switching into REG from another mode clears statistical memory automatically. If you are already in REG with an old list, clear before a new question:

keys
SHIFT→9→1→EXE

SHIFT 9 is CLR; item 1 is Stat. Leaving REG for COMP, CMPLX, BASE, or PRGM also clears the list.

Choose regression type (two menu screens)

After MODE 5, the calculator shows a regression menu. Only 1–4 appear on the first screen. Press ▶ (RIGHT) for a second screen with Inv, Quad, and AB-Exp.

Screen 1 (after MODE 5):

1 — Lin (linear)
2 — Log (logarithmic)
3 — Exp (exponential e)
4 — Pwr (power)

Screen 2 (press ▶ from screen 1):

1 — Inv (inverse) — MODE 5 ▶ 1
2 — Quad (quadratic) — MODE 5 ▶ 2
3 — AB-Exp (y = AB^x) — MODE 5 ▶ 3

You can also switch type later with SHIFT 2 → 3 (TYPE) while still in REG.

Input format — (x, y) then DT

After MODE 5 and your regression type, enter each pair as x , y DT. The comma is the key between 0 and EXP (same as SD frequency separator). DT is the blue M+ key in REG.

Pattern for one point:

x , y DT
Example: 1 , 2 DT registers (1, 2)

Line = on the display counts stored pairs. Scroll with ▲ / ▼ to review. When every pair is entered, press AC once to leave the editor — then recall results with S-VAR. Recalling coefficients while still browsing the list often gives wrong values.

Frequency (FreqOn / FreqOff)

Same SETUP option as SD. FreqOn (default): x , y DT counts once, or x , y ; f DT repeats that pair f times. FreqOff: only x , y DT — using ; gives Syntax ERROR.

Output — SHIFT 2 (S-VAR)

After AC, SHIFT 2 opens S-VAR. Press 1 for the VAR submenu, then ▶ to move to later screens. Each child page lists the recalls for its model. In general:

SHIFT 2 → 1 (VAR), screen 1: x̄ (1), xσn (2), xσn−1 (3)
SHIFT 2 → 1 → ▶: ȳ (1), yσn (2), yσn−1 (3)
SHIFT 2 → 1 → ▶ → ▶: A (1), B (2), r or C (3) — on Quad, item 3 is C (no r)
Estimate ŷ from x: type x, then SHIFT 2 → 1 → ◀ item 2 (Lin/Log/Exp/Pwr/Inv/AB-Exp) or ◀ item 3 (Quad)
Estimate x from y: type y, then SHIFT 2 → 1 → ◀ item 1 (Lin/Log/Exp/Pwr/Inv/AB-Exp); Quad has two x̂ values on ◀ 1 and ◀ 2

SHIFT 1 (S-SUM) recalls Σx, Σy, n, Σx², Σxy, and other sums used internally. SHIFT 2 → 3 (TYPE) switches regression type without entering VAR.

Minimum pairs and limits

  • Lin, Log, Exp, Pwr, Inv, AB-Exp: at least 2 (x, y) pairs
  • Quad: at least 3 (x, y) pairs (three coefficients A, B, C)
  • FreqOn: up to 26 stored records; FreqOff: up to 40
  • Data Full if you exceed the limit — delete rows or collapse repeats with FreqOn
  • Wrong model (e.g. Lin on curved data) can still show a moderate r — pick the shape that matches the scatter
note

Viewing, editing, and deleting pairs matches SD: ▲/▼ to browse, type a new value and EXE to replace (do not press DT), SHIFT DT (CL) to delete the displayed pair. Press MODE 1 when finished with statistics.
